library_preparation_preflight.summary: httpclient5 needs no extra dependency, Docker image or environment setup. The existing 5.2.1 test is in-memory (BasicAuthCache serialization round-trip). Wider coverage such as request building, auth schemes, cookies, URI and TLS-config helpers can use the already-declared httpclient5 artifact and its transitive httpcore5/httpcore5-h2/slf4j-api. Live HTTP tests can use a loopback server from httpcore5's own classes or the JDK's com.sun.net.httpserver. The truncated issue log shows only the native-image build banner, not a failing symbol, so it gives no evidence of a setup gap or of an unsupportable mechanism.
risks: The issue log is truncated before the actual native-image run failure, so the root cause is unconfirmed. It is most likely missing reachability metadata for the 5.3 version, or serialization/reflection differences from 5.2.1, and should be resolved by running the reproducer locally.

The issue reproducer runs coordinates 5.2.1 with GVM_TCK_LV=5.3. Metadata for httpcore5 and httpcore5-h2 is pinned to 5.2, while 5.3 resolves to httpcore5 5.2.4, so the dependency metadata versions should be checked.
